display.purpose: Fraunces titles; original font retained when lang_characters is nonempty.

label.purpose: Small actions, slider values, checkbox labels.

node.purpose: BattlefieldArt draws upright counts with Fonts.unitFont at 0.70r cap height, fitting within 1.44r. The generated gameFont remains available to other native renderers.

unit.purpose: BattlefieldArt uses Fonts.unitFont; troop cap height=min(0.0225W,1.32ry), width limit=1.65rx. Rig cap height=0.79size, width limit=1.20size. Shared font scale and color are restored after each label.

shadows.name: button-depth
shadows.value: s=max(1.5px,0.0042W); opaque ink at (+0.5s,-max(0,0.008W-press)); 9% ink at (+s,-0.012W)
shadows.purpose: Native bottom-left coordinates; face y is also reduced by press. Automatic for touchable non-silent buttons below 0.13H, or explicit shadow.

shadows.name: node-depth
shadows.value: Approved Canvas shadow: rgba(40,35,31,0.20), blur=0.14r, offset=(+0.035r,+0.09r) in the source Canvas downward y axis; exported with the material.
shadows.purpose: The tight contact shadow follows the original plain or seven-spike contour. Runtime displays the exported asset upright.

shadows.name: node-face
shadows.value: Original Canvas material, without Java gradient approximation. Rim linear gradient from (-0.35r,-r) to (+0.35r,+r), stops 0/0.50/1. Contour width=max(0.7,0.017r). Face shape scale=0.943, offset=(-0.012r,-0.025r); radial gradient from (-0.39r,-0.47r,0) to (0,0,1.25r), stops 0/0.53/1. Glow clipped to 0.98r: center=(-0.35r,-0.50r), radius=0.48r, white alpha=0.25 to 0. Shine: arc center=(-0.012r,-0.025r), radius=0.84r, angle=1.07pi to 1.57pi, round width=0.067r; linear white-alpha stops 0/0.82/0 at 0/0.35/1 from (-0.85r,-0.35r) to (0,-0.90r).
shadows.purpose: Source Canvas coordinates have downward y. Exact material is exported into twenty 256px atlas cells, nominal radius 96; runtime cell bounds=8r/3. The source, provenance, and assets govern exact pixels.

shadows.name: slider-depth
shadows.value: 12% ink disc at (x+1px,y-0.004W); face at y+0.002W, radius circleSize-0.004W

shadows.name: speed-handle-depth
shadows.value: 16% ink underlay at y-0.003H beneath the handle; solid ink rim inset by max(1.5px,0.004W)
shadows.purpose: Shallow handle depth in both themes.

motion.name: button-press
motion.purpose: Native engine feedback while selected; not a millisecond duration or a hover animation.

motion.name: speed-handle
motion.value: While dragging: halfWidth=0.10W+0.004W; height=0.87 Ã— cardHeight. Rest: halfWidth=0.10W; height=0.81 Ã— cardHeight. After drag: x += 0.2 Ã— (snappedX-x).
motion.purpose: Transient handle growth and native settling toward the displayed nearest stop.

motion.name: factory-contour
motion.value: Existing candy atlas deformed by an adaptive shared-corner mesh. At radius rho and angle a, radial scale is 1+smooth((rho/r-0.30)/0.70)*(0.078*sin(5*a-phase)+0.027*sin(3*a+0.63*phase)+0.028*sin(2.3*phase)); phase=0.90*tactics.elapsed+0.013*x+0.017*y. Reduced motion fixes phase=0 and removes the final breathing term. Counts are drawn separately and remain upright. No Conveyor marks.
motion.purpose: Factory identity and activity live in the contour; the center number stays still. Simulation time holds the shape when paused.

motion.name: rig-work
motion.value: Cache displayedFront per blueprint link and construction cost. While crew>0 and simulation dt>0: displayedFront+=(max(displayedFront,BattlefieldVisuals.front(link))-displayedFront)*(1-exp(-dt/0.12)). At crew==0 retain the exact last displayed front; do not chase the model target. Simulation-clock dt==0 holds the pose when paused. Visual phase=displayedFront*constructionCost; rendered drum input=0.36*visualPhase. Dust only with crew>0. Reduced motion fixes drum input at zero and removes dust.
motion.purpose: Smooth only the displayed rig pose across the existing integer resource front and its catch-up plateaus. No hull shake, bounce, resource-rule change, or continued movement at zero.

motion.name: digger-intake
motion.value: Incoming center d=from+progress*(to-from), using ordinary troop travel without a rear-intake clamp. intake=1-smooth(max(0,from+constructionProgress()*(to-from)-d)/(0.046W)); ordinary matte shell sx=rx*(1+0.06*outgoing-0.10*incoming)*(1-0.36*intake), sy=ry*(1-0.26*intake). Numeral height=min(0.0225W,1.32ry) and maximum width=1.65rx keep the original, untapered radii through the actual one-time crew transfer.
motion.purpose: The shell narrows into the rear intake while the center keeps moving normally and the full-size count remains upright on the route. The >50 group keeps its existing tank form.

motion.name: troop-transfer
motion.value: Route position drives a broad connected bulge and narrowing waist. Reciprocal axial/across stretch preserves the fleet body area. The outline opening seals with the bridge. After actual friendly transfer, the unnumbered remainder folds into the rim over 0.28s; node deformation settles over 0.38s. Reduced motion suppresses this deformation.
motion.purpose: Upright counts remain separate from shell deformation; dispatch and arrival obey the existing model.

motion.name: enemy-contact
motion.value: Contact crescent plus five soft radial-alpha vapor puffs and two tiny hot flecks move outward from the approach rim. Duration=0.56s; alpha=0.72*(1-u)^1.35 for puffs. Reduced motion shows only a static warm arc for age<0.18s.
motion.purpose: Finite enemy contact stays outside the centered node count, without map shake or hit-stop.

motion.name: cannon-shot
motion.value: Twelve rounded tube sections, tapered and gently curved, attached beyond the centered number. Armed width and mouth=1.5x. Opening reaches full dilation at 0.09s, settles by 0.29s, and recoil settles by 0.30s. Ball releases at 0.09s and flies for 0.24s, followed by the existing target puff. Ball radius=max(0.0055W,0.12r), black #24242A with #73757C glint; Night uses a theme-outline rim. Reduced motion suppresses travel and tube deformation.
motion.purpose: Soft opening and a small black projectile follow the real shot event; presentation does not delay model damage.

themes.behavior: Changes mutate retained UiStyle Color objects and recolor menu fonts immediately. Colored-button labels retain dark ink. BattlefieldArt uses a fixed candy palette and battlefield-number for counts in both themes; routes and AI home names use theme roles.

backgrounds.chapter: max(0, levelIndex) / 30 using integer division; tutorial index 0 belongs to the first group
backgrounds.selection: motif=floorMod(chapter,6); drift=(chapter%7)*0.019; tint cycles cyan, green, gold
backgrounds.context: Menus: highest unlocked chapter. Campaign map: current level chapter. Skirmish/editor: chapter 0.
backgrounds.geometry: Two edge discs (0.48 and 0.47 Ã— width), three bands, 32 line segments per band, stroke=0.0035 Ã— width
backgrounds.opacity: Day discs 0.045 and lines 0.10; Night discs 0.055 and lines 0.13; multiplied by scene alpha
backgrounds.motion: Static; no clock, randomness, or gameplay-state consumption

speedControl.card: 0.94W Ã— 0.066H at left 0.03W, top 0.09H; paper fill; track inset 0.11W on both sides
speedControl.rail: outline width 0.016W; gold progress width 0.008W; outline stop radii 0.007W, or 0.011W for 1x; hole radius 0.0035W, gold through the selected index and paper after it
speedControl.handle: width 0.20W; height 0.81 Ã— cardHeight; pressed half-width adds 0.004W and height becomes 0.87 Ã— cardHeight; inset max(1.5px,0.004W); dark Fonts.smallFont label
speedControl.input: Tap away applies immediately. Grabbing the handle preserves pointer offset. Index=round(clamp(position,0,1) Ã— 12). One pointer owns the drag; touchCancelled releases ownership and preserves the last value. Left/Right steps a focused control.

speedControl.nearbyControls: Pacts: 0.21W Ã— 0.052H, left 0.52W, top 0.025H. Target banner: top 0.18H.

haptics.name: speed-step
haptics.value: UiHaptics.speedStep(); minimum interval 70ms; changed stop only
haptics.platform: Android native View.performHapticFeedback: API 34+ SEGMENT_FREQUENT_TICK, otherwise CLOCK_TICK; respects system haptic settings. Desktop defaults to a no-op.
haptics.verification: Source and automated event behavior can be checked without a device; physical haptic feel is not verified.

battlefield.authority: The approved variant-C.png establishes the base; later explicit decisions in .impeccable/mocks/battlefield/2026-10-21/DECISIONS.md supersede its composition. Current references: fine-ink-troops.html, cozy-digging-rig.html, liquid-troop-flow.html. The rejected 0.6.0 screenshot is not design authority. This corrective rebuild implements that approved world; it does not request another world choice. The scoped organic factory/bomb/cannon brief at .impeccable/mocks/battlefield/2026-10-30/DECISIONS.md supersedes the former Conveyor and rigid barrel.

colorblind.nodes: Whole candy surface uses the ordinary material palettes except yellow, which uses the violet palette. No original opaque atlas overlay, inset disc, or replacement ring.

rimNotches.count: FractionType.ordinal(): green=1, red=2, yellow=3, cyan=4; neutral=0
rimNotches.geometry: Angle=0.62+(i-(marks-1)/2)*0.14; radial endpoints=0.63r and 0.72r; width=0.04r; white alpha=0.72. Transparent marks lie on the existing candy surface.

battlefield.tower: Original continuous seven-spike Canvas outline: half-angle=0.155rad; shoulders at 1.145r and +/-0.018rad, curved tip control at 1.18r. Fourteen shield slots, two per gap. Native slot center=pi/2-floor(i/2)*2pi/7-pi/7+(i%2===0?0.12:-0.12); arc=center+/-0.072, radius=1.085r. Base dark-cyan width=max(0.0030W,0.057r); light-cyan over-stroke width=max(0.0019W,0.042r), center raised by 0.008r. One segment per shield; no shield numeral or badge.
battlefield.economy: Existing candy atlas deformed by an adaptive shared-corner mesh. At radius rho and angle a, radial scale is 1+smooth((rho/r-0.30)/0.70)*(0.078*sin(5*a-phase)+0.027*sin(3*a+0.63*phase)+0.028*sin(2.3*phase)); phase=0.90*tactics.elapsed+0.013*x+0.017*y. Reduced motion fixes phase=0 and removes the final breathing term. Counts are drawn separately and remain upright. No Conveyor marks.
battlefield.routes: Fine ink: theme-outline stroke=0.0018W. Two-way route is one line at 85% alpha. Directed route is standalone repeated chevrons at 90% alpha; spacing=0.0256W, arm=0.006W, transverse factor=0.86. End boundary=1.20r for a Tower, 1.13r otherwise, plus 0.005W clearance. No faction center, shadow, or fixed five-chevron limit.
battlefield.constructionRoute: Solid completed line at 0.0018W, 85% theme outline; ahead of rig, dots are 0.002W long, spaced 0.012W at 0.0015W width and 45% theme muted.
battlefield.troops: Matte oval: rx=min(0.038W,W*(0.020+sqrt(value)*0.0012)); ry=0.73rx. Fine faction contour=0.0019W; free-travel board separation margin=0.0018W. No bevel, shine, or drop shadow. Count height=min(0.0225W,1.32ry), maximum width=1.65rx. Groups above 50 use the rounded tank at size=0.029W; 32 oval-contour segments leave the contact neck open when attached.
battlefield.rig: One route-centered rounded warm hull with the original top-to-bottom gradient, soft treads, rounded drum, recessed rear intake, and inset count pocket. Size=0.029W; for s=size/22, hull height=26s and corner=10s; drum=12s x 15s, corner=6s at +29s; treads height=8s, corner=4s at +/-12s. Hull uses its 48px NinePatch splits; other boxes use the 16px rounded primitive. Pocket radii=14.2s x 9.2s; count cap height=0.79size, max width=1.20size. Pocket offset is selected forward along the route from 0,0.6,1.2,1.8,2.4size, eased with the existing 0.15s real-frame time constant to clear crossings while leaving the rear intake clear. The hull stretches along the route around it. No leader line, sideways count, body shake, or bounce. RigMotion caches the displayed front and smooths toward max(displayedFront,realFront) with a 0.12 simulation-second time constant only while crew>0. At zero, the displayed front and phase freeze exactly without chasing the model target. A paused simulation clock holds both. Visual phase=displayedFront*constructionCost; drum input=0.36*visualPhase. The integer model front and catch-up plateaus remain unchanged. The rig center maps displayedFront onto the ordinary troop corridor and adds 1.7size so incoming groups can meet its rear intake.
battlefield.names: Only the AI home node carries its name: Simple Joe, Savvy Jane, or Silly Sam. No ordinary-node AI badges or names. Names are omitted in the editor.
battlefield.modelBoundary: Preserve model geometry, camera behavior, troop speeds, arrival and one-time transfer rules, combat, visibility, costs, and immediate artillery damage. Integer resource progress and catch-up plateaus remain unchanged. RigMotion smooths only the displayed front using simulation time; at zero it holds the exact last displayed front and drum phase. Incoming diggers retain uninterrupted ordinary travel until actual model contact.
battlefield.preview: The single static inline SVG battlefield sample transcribes source gradients and geometry. The exported PNG atlas and native renderers govern exact pixels and animation. The SVG is not a separately browser-verified runtime component.

primitives.rigHull: 256x128, 48px rounded corners and NinePatch splits; top #F6E8BA to bottom #DEC88F
primitives.vapor: 128x128 radial white alpha mask: radius=63px; alpha=1 at 0, 0.88 at 0.4, 0 at 1

material.coordinates: Original Canvas, positive y downward; exported texture displayed upright by native renderers.
material.geometry: Retain the original towerShape and material functions. See node-face and node-depth extension tokens for the source geometry and light.

tank.geometry: For s=size/15: board clearance rounded box=40s x 30s, corner=9s; treads=30s x 6s, corner=3s at +/-9s; six ridges per tread; barrel from +9s to +20s with width=4.2s in faction contour. Outer hull=29.5s x 17.5s, corner=6.75s; inner matte hull=28s x 16s, corner=6s; center shifted +1s. Counts stay upright on route.
tank.hull: Uses the ordinary matte troop fill and contour; yellow becomes violet in colorblind mode.

contacts.nodeMesh: Adaptive 12/16/20-cell mesh of the original candy atlas, fixed upper-left light; peak contact extension=0.33r.
contacts.neck: Adaptive 8/20-strip gradient bridge, 8 below a 20-pixel projected node radius. Broad root, cubic narrowing waist, and 1.30*attachment opening close with the fleet outline. Packed fill/edge mesh, with shared endpoint colors.
contacts.enemy: Crescent at 1.03r; five outward radial puffs and two tiny hot flecks; clears in 0.56s.
contacts.reducedMotion: No necks, contour deformation, or moving vapor; short static contact mark only.
contacts.merge: At actual transfer, a value/owner/time snapshot paints an unnumbered remainder for 0.28 simulation seconds. The destination count updates once; pooled Unit objects are not retained.
contacts.countLayer: Travelling fleet counts are rendered above nodes and equipment until actual transfer.

battlefield.evidenceBoundary: These paths identify native captures and actual-model output, not an acceptance verdict. Exclude stale 12-reduced-motion.png captures; the current reduced-motion state is 13-reduced-motion.png. Source and asset documentation does not certify motion feel or a separate browser render of the illustrative sidecar.

rigCorridor.boundary: Display placement only; incoming troop centers keep their original ordinary-travel calculation and model contact.

incomingDiggers.center: Uninterrupted ordinary travel: d=from+progress*(to-from), with no clamp to the rig rear.
incomingDiggers.shell: Smoothstep taper over the final 0.046W before constructionProgress() contact; reduce longitudinal radius by up to 36% and transverse radius by up to 26%.
incomingDiggers.count: Use the original untapered rx and ry to size the upright numeral until actual one-time crew transfer.
incomingDiggers.model: Existing movement, arrival, resource use, and transfer remain authoritative.

motionEvidence.frontMeaning: front is the displayed cached front; model_front is BattlefieldVisuals.front(link). phase is displayedFront*constructionCost.
sourceAssertions: Displayed front never moves backward beyond 1e-6 tolerance between newly rendered native poses.
Two consecutive newly rendered positive-crew poses without displayed-front progress fail: delta<1e-7 on two successive newly rendered samples.
Two consecutive newly rendered approaching-troop poses without travel progress fail: route-distance delta<1e-5 on two successive newly rendered samples.
Consecutive zero-crew samples from newly rendered poses require displayed front and phase differences below 1e-9.
The fixture must observe idle, restart, friendly contact, enemy contact, and both ordinary troop arrivals.
motionEvidence.boundary: The assertions and CSV schema describe the native source harness. The paths identify generated evidence; they do not state the release-review verdict.
motionEvidence.sampling: Probe assertions and CSV rows use only newly rendered native poses, identified by a changed route renderIndex. The engine may present cached frames under load; original frame and time values preserve those gaps. These samples do not establish continuous 60 FPS. PNG compression runs off the render thread.

battlefield.bombs: Matte faction oval, ry=0.73rx, fine contour, eight-segment curved fuse, tiny gold/copper sparks. Legacy courier shows BOMB_CREW=2; converted bomb has no invented troop population. Waiting bombs use MobileBomb.position() so the drawing and touch point agree. Owner-only visibility remains. Reduced motion retains a static ember.
battlefield.cannon: Twelve rounded tube sections, tapered and gently curved, attached beyond the centered number. Armed width and mouth=1.5x. Opening reaches full dilation at 0.09s, settles by 0.29s, and recoil settles by 0.30s. Ball releases at 0.09s and flies for 0.24s, followed by the existing target puff. Ball radius=max(0.0055W,0.12r), black #24242A with #73757C glint; Night uses a theme-outline rim. Reduced motion suppresses travel and tube deformation.

organicEvidence.boundary: Native desktop renderer captures; physical phone frame rate and haptics are not established by these images.

orderArrow.shape: Antialiased rounded filled arrow with short stem in the shared managed UiStyle atlas
orderArrow.face: node faction face; yellow becomes violet in colorblind mode
orderArrow.position: 1.55r along order angle, 0.77r beside travel lane

liquidEvidence.sampleTime: 1/30 simulation second; two real 60 Hz unit steps per pose
liquidEvidence.boundary: Native renderer at phone dimensions; Android emulator remains paused; GIF export is not an FPS measurement.

narrative.overview:
Warm paper, rounded ink lines, and restrained yellow actions make the strategy easy to read and operate. Night mode keeps the same layout with dark surfaces and cream menu text. Bright candy nodes sit above quieter matte troops and fine routes. Fraunces titles give menus character; Quicksand carries choices and numbers.

This documents the implemented libGDX canvas. Menu styling retains the [Inkwell Stars](https://inkwellgames.com/games/stars/tutorial) reference. Battlefield authority is the approved [Crisp buttons direction and later decisions](.impeccable/mocks/battlefield/2026-10-21/DECISIONS.md), including Fine ink, the cozy digging rig, and liquid troop flow. The [30 October organic details](.impeccable/mocks/battlefield/2026-10-30/DECISIONS.md) replace the factory Conveyor, bomb glyph and rigid cannon barrel. The existing candy material stays in the managed atlas; `BattlefieldArt` and the game renderers supply its contours and equipment. The [3 November arrow and liquid-contact decisions](.impeccable/mocks/battlefield/2026-11-03/DECISIONS.md) refine the sending indicator and ordinary troop contact.
keyCharacteristics: Bright candy nodes with a narrow bevel and fixed upper-left light.
Softer matte troops, fine contours, and fine ink routes.
Rounded overhead equipment with upright counts inside the body and on the route.
Wavy, softly pulsing factories; quiet curved fuses and soft overhead cannons.
Brief motion tied to actual troop, construction, and combat events.
dos: Do use plain action labels and show costs before a player spends units.
Do keep the board clear enough to follow routes and read node counts.
Do preserve language coverage, whole-surface colorblind materials and rim notches, and visible keyboard focus.
Do preserve the softer matte troop palette, with violet fill and contour for the yellow faction in colorblind mode.
Do export the original approved node material and retain its provenance when rebuilding assets.
Do keep every troop and rig count inside its body and centered on its route.
Do keep appearance choices saved, with Day and plain backgrounds as the defaults.
Do check affected states on desktop and phone before release.
donts: Don't add competing primary menu actions or repeated explanations.
Don't add perpetual decorative motion or manipulative progression prompts.
Don't use light menu text on yellow or faction-colored faces.
Don't add shield counters, detached upgrade badges, or AI labels on ordinary nodes.
Don't give troops the raised candy material reserved for nodes.
Don't restore opaque colorblind atlas overlays, inset discs, or replacement rings.
Don't replace the approved gradients, contours, shine, shadows, or rounded vehicle geometry with approximations.
Don't replace the native canvas conventions with a generic web or Material interface.
